description: This Java class 'FrameHelper' provides utility methods for managing and initializing JFrame components within a GUI application. It includes methods to display frames, initialize frame properties, handle window events, and logs window open/close events.

classes.name: FrameHelper
classes.description: A helper class to facilitate the creation, display, and management of JFrame windows with event handling and logging.

methods.name: getFrame
methods.description: Returns the JFrame instance managed by this helper.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Displays the provided component within the frame, with optional maximization at start.

methods.name: initFrame
methods.description: Initializes the frame size, close operation, adds window listeners, and embeds the component.

methods.name: onWindowOpened
methods.description: Callback invoked when the window is opened; logs the event.

methods.name: onWindowClosed
methods.description: Callback invoked when the window is closed; logs the event and closes logs.

methods.name: getDefaultFontSize
methods.description: Returns the default font size used in the window.
